# lgcw live qualification fixture

This repository is an isolated test target for a deterministic issue-to-PR workflow.
Keep changes bounded by the issue's acceptance criteria. Never merge or push to main.

`VERSION` is the canonical release metadata used by `calculator.py --version`.
Version-bump issues should change that file only, preserving the CLI and its tests.

Local gate and CI command:

```sh
uv run --python 3.13 --with pytest==9.1.1 python -m pytest -q tests
```

The required workflow/job pair is `CI / test`, on every pull request.
